summary: Your eighteenth teach-back. You explain to a colleague on call what to check first and why: up, errors, latency against a baseline, one request by its id, what changed, and write it down. The evidence is an ordered list and queries on 20 real requests (a rehearsal, not production), with what is normal written beside each number.
goal: Explain what you would check at 2 a.m.

items.text: Write the first three things you would check at 2 a.m. and one thing you would not do
Explain what you would check and why in that order, in 5 sentences or a 60-second voice note
Tick the six key points your explanation said clearly and count them
Check your explanation against the runbook, the queries and the baseline
Play the At 2 a.m. game to the end and see your score
